items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Here we go. What’s showing up now is Gary McFarland, September ’69, Curtis Fuller on trombone, you, Gary McFarland on vibes and vocal, George Ricci, cello, Sam Brown, guitar, Ron Carter and Chet Amsterdam

ctx.x: Memphis. That’s what you referenced earlier in this interview, about being called for that one. So that brings us up to date on that and at least gets us to there. Here we go. What’s showing up now is Gary McFarland, September ’69, Curtis Fuller on
trombone, you, Gary McFarland on vibes and vocal, George Ricci, cello, Sam Brown, guitar, Ron Carter and Chet Amsterdam, and then Grady Tate and Sol Gubin, and then Airto.
